title: Joining strict safety intervals
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape machine over the Boolean alphabet with state set $S$, let $a,b$ be natural numbers, and let $r\in S$ be an anchor state. Suppose the run from configuration $c$ reaches $d$ after $a$ steps, no configuration from time $0$ through time $a$ inclusive in the run from $c$ has state $r$, and no configuration at any time $j<b$ in the run from $d$ has state $r$. Then no configuration at any time $j<a+b$ in the run from $c$ has state $r$.
hypotheses_covered: Machine $M$ over Boolean symbols with state set $S$
The run from $c$ reaches $d$ after $a$ steps
The run from $c$ avoids state $r$ at every time $j\leq a$
The run from $d$ avoids state $r$ at every time $j<b$
replaced:
If the run from $c$ reaches $d$ in $a$ anchor-free steps and the run from
$d$ avoids the anchor at all times strictly before $b$, then the run from
$c$ avoids the anchor at all times strictly before $a + b$, even when time
$a + b$ itself returns to the anchor.
